title_en: [Graduate School] ★ Submission of Final Approved Theses (Archival Copies) for Semester 1 of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: Master's and doctoral students expected to graduate in Semester 1 of the 2026 academic year must submit documents to the department office from 20 to 24 July 2026 (by 17:00) and upload their final thesis online via dCollection from 17 July to 3 August 2026 (by 23:59). Both parts must be completed, and students who do not submit the Thesis Submission Confirmation and the approval page will be excluded from the conferral of degrees.
applies_to: Master's and doctoral students expected to graduate in Semester 1 of the 2026 academic year. This includes students who did not submit their archival thesis last semester and doctoral students who applied for an extension of the review period, if they are graduating this semester.

dates.what: Online thesis submission period (dCollection); no corrections, replacements or extensions after the deadline
Recommended latest time to complete the online submission on the deadline day
dates.when: By 10:00 on the deadline day (3 August 2026)

dates.what: Submission period for documents at the department office (Building 301, Room 319)
Files uploaded to dCollection may still be modified until this date, even after documents are submitted to the department office
Example dates to write on the approval page (example only): thesis submission date / thesis approval date
dates.when: Submission date: July 2026; approval date: August 2026

steps: Obtain the committee members' signatures (or seals) on the approval page well in advance; no extension is given for any reason, including late signatures. If any signature is a copy (e.g., an online signature), keep the full email correspondence with that committee member as evidence; otherwise obtain a handwritten signature or seal.
Return any overdue library books and pay any library fines, because the Thesis Submission Confirmation cannot be printed otherwise.

Upload your thesis at http://dcollection.snu.ac.kr (Central Library website > Library Services > Theses > Online Thesis Submission [중앙도서관 홈페이지 > 도서관서비스 > 학위논문 > 학위논문 온라인 제출]) between 17 July 2026 and 3 August 2026, 23:59. Upload two files: (1) the final thesis as a single PDF under 100 MB, including an approval page showing only the committee members' names with no signatures; and (2) the approval page bearing the committee members' signatures or seals, as a separate file. Consent to the use of the full text of the thesis (mandatory).
Print the Thesis Submission Confirmation [학위논문 제출 확인서] from dCollection (see Attachment 02, Online Thesis Submission Manual, page 17), checking that your department, degree name and name are correct.

Submit the Thesis Submission Confirmation, the original approval page, and, if any signature is a copy, the printed evidence (the full email exchange with each such committee member) to the department office (Building 301, Room 319) between 20 July 2026 and 24 July 2026, 17:00.

After uploading, check the uploaded file carefully for wrong files, page errors or missing content, and confirm that the degree name, department, author name, submission/approval dates and thesis title are correct. Complete any changes on dCollection by 3 August 2026, 23:59 (preferably by 10:00 that day); no changes are possible afterwards.
translation:
Master's and doctoral students expected to graduate in Semester 1 of the 2026 academic year are informed of the final thesis submission as follows. Eligible students must submit within the stated periods.

Submission is complete only when BOTH items below are completed: 1. Submission to the department office, and 2. Online submission.
※ Students who do not submit the Thesis Submission Confirmation and the approval page will be excluded from the conferral of degrees.

1. Submission to the Department Office (Building 301, Room 319)

- Submission period: 20 July 2026 (Monday) to 24 July 2026 (Friday), 17:00
 * Even after submitting documents to the department office, the file uploaded to dCollection may be modified until 3 August.

- Documents to submit

A. Thesis Submission Confirmation [학위논문 제출 확인서]
* Check for typos in your department, degree name, name, etc.: (1) From the 2014 entry cohort onward, department: College of Engineering, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering [공과대학 전기·정보공학부]; (2) Degree name: Master's [석사] or Doctoral [박사].
* Go to http://dcollection.snu.ac.kr, submit your thesis file, then print the "Thesis Submission Confirmation".
 ※ How to print the "Thesis Submission Confirmation": see the attachment (Attachment 02, Online Thesis Submission Manual, page 17).
* The Thesis Submission Confirmation cannot be printed if you have unreturned library books or overdue fines. Return your books and pay any fines before printing.

B. Approval page (original) [인준지]
* The approval page may be signed or sealed.
* If a signature is a copy, you must submit evidence (such as emails) confirming the committee member's intention to approve. Evidence is required for every committee member whose signature is a copy.

2. Online Thesis Submission

- Submission period: 17 July 2026 (Friday) to 3 August 2026 (Monday), 23:59
- Method: Go to http://dcollection.snu.ac.kr and submit your thesis file. * See the attachments (Attachments 01 and 02).
 * Where to submit: Central Library website > Library Services > Theses > Online Thesis Submission [중앙도서관 홈페이지 > 도서관서비스 > 학위논문 > 학위논문 온라인 제출] (https://dcollection.snu.ac.kr)
 * Consent to the use of the full text of the thesis is mandatory. After 3 August (Monday), 23:59, no modification, replacement or time extension is possible under any circumstances. Problems may occur if you make changes at the last minute, so please complete your submission with time to spare, by 10:00 on the deadline day at the latest.
 ※ No extension will be granted for any reason, including late approval-page signatures or health reasons, so please obtain the signatures in advance.
- Only one full-text PDF file may be uploaded, with a total size under 100 MB. If you need to compress images, refer to the Online Thesis Submission Manual (Attachment 02).
 ※ Upload the approval page bearing the committee members' signatures as a separate file.
 ※ For the archival thesis, do not submit a bound copy to the department office (Room 319); submit only the full-text file online to the library.
- After uploading, you must check the full-text file. Check thoroughly so that no wrong file is uploaded and no page errors occur. Please check once more that it is the correct final file (make sure nothing is missing).
- When submitting, check once more your degree name, department, author name, and submission date or approval date. (International students should pay particular attention to errors in English spelling.)
 * Korean: 전기·정보공학부 / English: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
 * Up to the 2013 entry cohort: 전기컴퓨터공학부; from the 2014 entry cohort onward: 전기·정보공학부
- When submitting, check the final thesis title.
 * The thesis title must match across: mySNU thesis title = approval page thesis title = title in the file uploaded to the library = library thesis title.
 If your title changed at any point, you must inform the staff member in charge at the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
 * It may differ from the thesis title written on the thesis review result documents (review summary, etc.).

★ (Must read!) How to submit the approval page

1) What is the approval page? It is the page in the thesis stating that the thesis "is approved as a ... thesis" ["~~ 학위논문을 인준함"].

2) How to prepare the approval page
- See the attachment (Attachment 03, Thesis Writing Guidelines and Templates → (kor.) template, thesis writing guidelines). ※ Example: Thesis submission date: July 2026 // Thesis approval date: August 2026
- The submission date and approval date must fall within this semester. Because approval takes place after submission, the approval date must be after the submission deadline. (Using the same date for submission and approval is recommended.)
- Master's: Chair, Vice-Chair (advisor), Member / Doctoral: Chair, Vice-Chair (advisor), 3 Members
- The cover and the approval page must each be submitted as a single page and must not run onto a second page. (Important)

3) How to submit the approval page
The final thesis must be uploaded including an approval page that shows only the committee members' names, without their signatures (or seals). The approval page bearing the committee members' signatures (or seals) must be uploaded as a separate file.
(1) Final thesis (approval page without signatures) (2) Approval page (with signatures)
That is, you must upload two separate files, and both must be uploaded by the deadline for the thesis to be accepted as submitted.

4) Cautions
- Modification or replacement is not possible, so check carefully before uploading.
- Examples of typos: wrong degree name, wrong department, wrong author name, wrong submission/approval date, etc.
- If a student who did not submit the archival thesis last semester, or a doctoral student who applied for an extension of the review period, is graduating this semester, the approval date and submission date must fall within this semester, not last semester.
- The approval page itself is the basis for conferring the degree. Even if you already obtained signatures dated last semester, you must obtain them again based on this semester.

5) Electronic signatures
- If one or more committee members signed online:
 * Evidence is required for every committee member whose signature is a copy. If there is no such evidence, a handwritten signature or seal is required.
 * When submitting the approval page to the department office, you must also submit the evidence. *Evidence: the entire email exchange with the committee member regarding the online signature (printed).
- Example 1) If you first obtained handwritten signatures from 3 of 5 committee members and then online signatures from the remaining 2, you must submit all of documents (1) to (3):
 (1) Original approval page: the approval page with the handwritten signatures
 (2) Approval page: the approval page containing all committee members' signatures
 (3) Evidence
- Example 2) If you first obtained online signatures from 2 of 5 committee members and then handwritten signatures from the remaining 3, you must submit both documents (1) and (2):
 (1) Approval page: the approval page containing all committee members' signatures
 (2) Evidence for the 2 online signatures

3. No modification, correction or cancellation after the approval page is submitted

- After the final approved thesis is submitted, no corrections may be submitted other than corrections of obvious typographical errors.
 * See the attachment (Attachment 04: Guide to Submitting Corrections to Final Approved Master's/Doctoral Theses (Archival Copies)).
 * Once submitted, a thesis cannot be modified or replaced for any reason. Supreme Court rulings and similar precedents also strictly prohibit changes to the content of a thesis already submitted.
- After submitting, be sure to check for yourself that the full-text file was uploaded correctly without errors.

4. Inquiries

- Online file submission: Central Library, Academic Information Operations Team (contact details are in the original notice)
 * KakaoTalk inquiries: KakaoTalk Plus Friend ID: snuthesis (KakaoTalk > Find Friends (magnifying glass at top) > Search by ID)
 * Available hours: weekdays 09:00–18:00 (not available on weekends or public holidays)
- Document submission to the department office: the department office (Building 301, Room 319); contact details are in the original notice.

Attachments (4) — the contents of these attachments were not read; only their titles are given:
1. Thesis Submission Guide (for students), Korean/English (.zip)
2. Online Thesis Submission Manual, Korean/English (.zip)
3. Thesis Writing Guidelines and Templates (.zip)
4. Guide to Submitting Corrections to Final Approved Theses, Korean/English (.zip)
